description:
This plugin allows users to sign in through an SSO provider (such as Google, Facebook, or your own provider). This enables one-click signin.
Fork of 9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso with native (Android) app login fixed.
Review documentation at https://github.com/danbro96/jellyfin-plugin-sso
name: SSO Authentication
overview: Authenticate users against an SSO provider.

versions.changelog:
Clicking the SSO button now shows a loading spinner immediately (served from the OIDC start endpoint) that persists through the redirect chain until you land in the app — no more blank gap before sign-in completes.

Same plugin GUID — updates in place.

- **Login UX:** the post-callback page is now a centered full-viewport spinner instead of plain top-left text. Pairs with an instant overlay on the Jellyfin login button (Branding → Login disclaimer) so there's immediate feedback through the whole SSO redirect chain.
- **CI:** all workflows forced onto Node 24 (`FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24`) + bumped `actions/checkout@v5` / `actions/setup-dotnet@v5` — clears the Node 20 deprecation warnings.

Same plugin GUID — updates in place over 4.1.0.0.

Fork of [9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso](https://github.com/9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso) with the **native Jellyfin app (Android) login hang fixed**.

- Resolve the device id via the `NativeShell` bridge (fallback: `_deviceId2`, then a generated id).
- Drop the hidden-iframe + localStorage busy-wait that never completed in native app webviews.
- Write `jellyfin_credentials` directly; surface callback errors instead of hanging silently.

Built for Jellyfin **10.11** (targetAbi 10.11.0.0). Same plugin GUID as upstream — installs/updates in place.

Add this repo as a plugin repository in Jellyfin → Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/danbro96/jellyfin-plugin-sso/manifest-release/manifest.json`
